exposure: thrombocytopenia at the time of delivery
moderate to severe thrombocytopenia (platelet count of <100,000/µL)
outcome: Wound complications (surgical site infections, dehiscence, or hematoma)
cohort: 3,133 women who underwent cesarean delivery at a tertiary care hospital labor and delivery unit between September 2015 and June 2018
finding: Preoperative mild thrombocytopenia was not associated with increased risk of postpartum hemorrhage, red blood cell transfusion, wound complications, or postpartum emergency department visits in women undergoing cesarean delivery.
gest_age: Not specified, but all participants underwent cesarean delivery
